correctness.rationale: For the source's explicit g=10/7, h=8/5, sigma_g=sigma_h=-1 example, the retained p and qg modes form an additional triad whose third wavevector is outside the signed seven-mode support. The source's Eq. (5) gives nonzero forcing in both output-helicity channels, and the generating retained pair is unique, so no retained-pair cancellation is possible. This is also consistent with the published finite-Fourier-support classification of real 3D Euler flows.

originality.rationale: General Galerkin nonclosure and the Kishimoto-Yoneda classification are prior art and excluded from novelty. The claim is limited to the source-specific identification and evaluation of the omitted cross-triplet leakage in arXiv:2609.20710v1. No public correction or SCOPE overlap was found; the preprint's recency leaves residual risk of unindexed parallel comments or revisions.

value.rationale: The result changes the advertised status of the periodic object from an exact full-Euler solution and PDE benchmark to an exact orbit of a reduced seven-mode triad-network model, while preserving the reduced-model mathematics.
